home.headline: You Are Not Alone
home.subheadline: Many families face the same key figures and the same procedural patterns — each in isolation. This platform proves the pattern without exposing any individual case.
home.step1Body: Add structured facts — complaints, nzakut orders, documents. All encrypted client-side. The server never sees content.
home.step2Body: The system creates a digital signature for each pattern you identified and registers it on the blockchain before any connection between families is made.
home.step3Body: When enough families register the same figure + pattern combination, the count becomes visible. No names. No content. Just a count.
home.privacyBody: Cryptographic commitments are timestamped on-chain before you are ever connected to anyone. The timestamp proves independence.
home.legalTitle: A legal argument, not a complaint
home.legalBody: 24 families who never met registered the same procedural pattern against the same figure. Each timestamped on-chain before any connection. That is the argument.
